# Shop India

> Online shop offering quality products across fashion, electronics, footwear, accessories and more, with fast delivery across India.

Shop India is an e-commerce storefront with secure UPI, card and COD payments, easy 30-day returns, and a curated catalog of products from popular brands.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Featured deals, banners, and curated product carousels.
- [Shop](/shop): Full catalog with filters for category, brand, price, and rating.
- [Product Detail](/product/): Individual product pages with images, ratings, variants and reviews.
- [Wishlist](/wishlist): Saved products for signed-in customers.
- [Shipping & Delivery](/shipping): Delivery times, rates, and free shipping thresholds.
- [Returns & Refunds](/returns): 30-day return window with 7 flexible return options.

## Optional

- [Sign In](/auth): Customer account access.
- [My Account](/account): Order history and profile.
